_meta.title: Tier 1 — Amazon published restricted-product categories
_meta.purpose: The TYPE layer: which whole product categories Amazon restricts or prohibits, per marketplace. Compiled from Amazon's published Restricted Products policy (Seller Central help G200164330) and compliance references. Replaces the earlier offline-guessed category seed.
_meta.confidence_note: Category-level status is from Amazon's published policy + industry compliance references, accurate as of compile date. Amazon updates policy without notice. The DEFINITIVE per-ASIN, per-account answer is always Seller Central > Catalog > Add Products > 'Show limitations' / 'Apply to Sell'. 'Sell Yours' does NOT guarantee no restriction (brand approval / hazmat may still apply).
_meta.usage_rule: SOURCING ALARM + listing warning, never a copy-editing tool. PROHIBITED categories block normal submit (logged force-list only). RESTRICTED/GATED categories warn + surface docs. Absence from this list != safe.
_meta.layer_relationship: TYPE layer. Sits with tier2_restriction_triggers.json (ATTRIBUTE layer) and the user's Tier 3 violation notices. A product can pass this list but still hit an attribute trigger, or vice versa.

categories.label: Alcohol / alcoholic beverages
categories.detail: Alcohol generally prohibited; only pre-approved sellers may sell wine.

categories.label: Dietary supplements
categories.detail: Among the most closely monitored. Must be sealed original packaging, new, English labelling with product name/quantity/ingredients/manufacturer. Prohibited ingredients (e.g. ephedra). A supplement claiming to treat a disease becomes an unapproved DRUG.

categories.label: Cosmetics / skincare / topicals
categories.detail: Topicals (applied to skin) require approval. Prohibited ingredients: mercury, hydroquinone, bithionol, chloroform. See tier2 cosmetic_topical_ingredient for detail + docs.
docs: UK/EU: CPSR + SCPN/CPNP + INCI + Responsible Person
US: FDA reg, GMP, COA, invoice (180 days)

categories.label: Medical devices & accessories
categories.detail: Heavily gated. Class II devices need 510(k). Prescription/professional devices (e.g. nebulizers) limited to Professional Healthcare Program sellers. See tier2 medical_device for detail.
docs: US: FDA 510(k) + establishment reg + invoice + healthcare program

categories.label: Drugs, OTC medicines & drug paraphernalia
categories.detail: OTC drugs permitted with compliance; anything resembling prescription medicine or strong health claims restricted quickly. Drug paraphernalia restricted.

categories.label: CBD / hemp / cannabis products
categories.detail: Under increasingly rigorous scrutiny; largely restricted/prohibited on Amazon.
docs: verify per marketplace — often no path

categories.label: Hazmat / dangerous goods (flammable, aerosol, corrosive)
categories.detail: Flammable liquids, aerosols, corrosives, lithium batteries. Note: nail polish remover (acetone) is hazmat. Requires hazmat review/classification.

categories.label: Lithium batteries & products containing them
categories.detail: See tier2 lithium_battery — UN38.3 + UL certs mandatory. Scope huge (anything rechargeable).

categories.label: Weapons, firearms, ammunition, certain knives
categories.detail: Firearms, ammunition, many knives (esp. automatic/concealed) prohibited. UK knife laws stricter than US.

categories.label: Explosives, fireworks, pyrotechnics
categories.detail: Prohibited.

categories.label: Laser products
categories.detail: Laser pointers/products above certain classes restricted; FDA laser product regulation (US).

categories.label: Lock picking & theft devices
categories.detail: All prohibited EXCEPT blank keys.

categories.label: Surveillance / spy / hidden-camera equipment
categories.detail: Hidden cameras, covert surveillance devices restricted. Signal jammers prohibited.

categories.label: Radio / wireless transmitting equipment
categories.detail: Must meet Ofcom (UK) / FCC (US) power & certification. Jammers prohibited. Over-power transmitters (e.g. high-power FPV) prohibited UK. See tier2.

categories.label: Food, beverages & grocery
categories.detail: Shelf-life standards, labelling, safety. Consumables gated for health/safety.

categories.label: Composite wood products
categories.detail: Prohibited unless meeting EPA formaldehyde emission standards (US TSCA Title VI / CARB).

categories.label: Upholstered furniture
categories.detail: Flammability/safety testing; UK has specific fire-safety regs (fire label).

categories.label: Children's products / toys (under 12)
categories.detail: Safety testing + certification. US: CPC (Children's Product Certificate) under CPSIA. UK: toy safety testing.

categories.label: Pesticides & products making pesticide claims
categories.detail: EPA registration (US) / HSE biocide rules (UK). CRITICAL: a NON-pesticide product can be pulled in by pesticide-CLAIM language (kill/sanitize/antimicrobial) — this is the Mil-Gear case. Ties to claims screener.

categories.label: Jewelry, fine jewelry & precious gems
categories.detail: Quality/authenticity requirements; anti-fraud gating.

categories.label: Fine art
categories.detail: Approval required. Cannot sell: mass-produced works, promo posters, artwork without named artist, certain anthropological/textile art.

categories.label: Collectible coins & currency
categories.detail: Prior approval. Prohibited: altered legal tender, imitation/counterfeit currency, commemorative medals.

categories.label: Tobacco, e-cigarettes & vaping
categories.detail: Tobacco and vaping products prohibited.

categories.label: Animals & animal products
categories.detail: Cannot sell live pets, livestock, plant pests, marine mammals, endangered-species fur/feathers.

categories.label: Plant & seed products
categories.detail: Import/phytosanitary restrictions; some seeds/plants prohibited across borders.

categories.label: Recalled products
categories.detail: Any recalled product prohibited.

categories.label: Refrigerants / ozone-depleting substances
categories.detail: EPA (US) / F-gas (UK) regulated.

categories.label: Automotive & powersports
categories.detail: Category technically open but many subcategories (tyres, safety parts, emissions) require approval.

categories.label: Gambling, lottery & games of chance
categories.detail: Prohibited.

categories.label: Warranties, service plans, subscriptions
categories.detail: Require approval.

subcategory_warning: Top-level categories like Beauty, Health & Personal Care, Grocery, Clothing, Shoes, Toys, Baby are technically OPEN but have significant GATED subcategories underneath. New sellers hit these unexpectedly. This list captures the known restricted categories; subcategory gating is only fully visible via Seller Central 'Apply to Sell' per ASIN.
verification_method: Definitive check: Seller Central > Catalog > Add Products > search ASIN/name > 'Show limitations'. 'Apply to Sell' = restricted. 'Sell Yours' = likely open but NOT guaranteed (brand/hazmat may still apply).
account_specific_note: This is Amazon's GENERAL published policy. Gating is also ACCOUNT-SPECIFIC — a category open for one of the user's accounts may be gated for another. To make this list account-precise, paste the user's own Seller Central Restricted Products page per account.
